prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1342; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The injury does not fit the crash: the impact was very light, yet the claimed injury is severe.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of low back pain and stiffness. Over the course of 21 visits, care consisted of conservative management including physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment progressed in a typical pattern, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms gradually improved and the patient was discharged to self-directed exercise. On examination, paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion were documented, while neurological screening, including reflexes, strength, and sensation in the lower extremities, remained within normal limits. The patient reports no prior history of injury or treatment involving the lumbar region. The billing record reflects single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Given the low-speed nature of the impact described by the patient, the severity of the reported symptoms is noted for the record, though the clinical findings above are documented as observed.
